data.name: Ibrahim
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Avraham, traditionally 'father of many nations' (Genesis 17:5). Its root is Hebrew ʾ-b-r-h-m. The prophet Ibrāhīm (Abraham), the patriarch; Sūrat Ibrāhīm in the Qur'an. Ibrahim is a Arabic name meaning “Father of many; exalted father”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.gender_notes: Ibrahim is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
